The '''Archaeologist''' is a [[villager]] profession that sells [[explorer maps]], pottery sherds and the [[Archeologist's Brush]]. It replaces the {{MCW|Cartographer|cartographer}}, and its job site block is the Cartography Table. It is the only villager that sells maps to the [[Overgrown Abbey]] and the [[Papal Outpost]].

All trades can be used 999 times before restocking, and every level offers all of its trades.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/trade_set/cartographer/level_1.json}}</ref>

=== Maps ===
{{Main|Explorer maps}}
Every map costs a single obol, with no compass, compared with 8 to 14 emeralds and a compass for a vanilla cartographer's explorer map. The Overgrown Abbey map is the exception: it costs a copy of [[Paradise Lost]] or [[The Divine Comedy]] instead of an obol.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/3/abbey_paradise_lost.json}}</ref>

Each map searches for the nearest structure of its type within a radius of 100 chunks when the archaeologist reaches that level. If there is none, the map trade is not offered.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/1/mineshaft.json}}</ref> The Papal Outpost map targets pillager outposts, since papal outposts replace them.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/worldgen/structure/on_papal_outpost_explorer_maps.json}}</ref>

=== Pottery sherds ===
The archaeologist sells one pottery sherd per level for 1 obol: Sheaf, Howl, Snort, Mourner and Arms Up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/1/sheaf_pottery_sherd.json}}</ref>

=== Archeologist's Brush ===
At Apprentice level it sells the [[Archeologist's Brush]], an unbreakable brush, for 1 obol.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/2/brush.json}}</ref>

=== Clay fetishes ===
At Master level the archaeologist exchanges either kind of [[Clay Fetish]] (the cheerful one, "Rejoice", or the mournful one, "Lament") for a [[Crystal Heart|crystal heart]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/5/cheerful_clay_statue.json}}</ref>

Like every villager, an archaeologist that has been traded with will also buy its [[favorite food]] once, an upcoming trade that is not in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2-beta]].

== Trivia ==
* The Desert Temple Map uses the desert village map marker, and the Trail Ruins Map uses the plains village marker.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/2/desert_temple.json}}</ref>
* The developer has described plans for the archaeologist to buy [[sacred texts]] in exchange for maps to structures: "The Moutpiece seeks wisdom, the Archaeologist seeks knowledge."<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref> The Overgrown Abbey map is the first trade of this kind.
* Internally the profession is still <code>minecraft:cartographer</code>; only its displayed name changes.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>
